payload.name: Scarcity-Induced Arousal Polarization
payload.fact: Scarcity salience increases the choice share of the most-preferred item by inducing arousal that polarizes evaluations of items in a choice set.

provenance.title: Scarcity Polarizes Preferences: The Impact on Choice among Multiple Items in a Product Class
provenance.quote_or_locus: The results from five experiments show that scarcity versus abundance broadens the discrepancy between the liking of the favorite and nonfavorite items and leads to a greater choice share of the favorite item
